mapper.select: SELECT id, username, onboarding_complete, avatar_id, created_at, email, password_hash FROM users WHERE username = #{identifier} OR email = #{identifier} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, onboarding_complete, avatar_id, created_at, email, password_hash FROM users WHERE id = #{id}::uuid LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO players (user_id, name, room_id, x, y, direction, avatarId, last_updated) VALUES (#{userId}::uuid, #{name}, #{roomId}::uuid, #{x}, #{y}, #{direction}, #{avatarId}, now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, room_id) DO UPDATE SET name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, players.name), x = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.x, players.x), y = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.y, players.y), direction = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.direction, players.direction), avatarId = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.avatarId, players.avatarId), last_updated = now()
